caption: The drawing consists of a large, off-white rectangular background with a slightly smaller, centrally placed pale blue rectangle. Inside the blue rectangle, there are nine identical, evenly spaced gold or yellow leaf-shaped motifs arranged in three rows, with three motifs in each row. A scale is present at the lower left corner of the background, and handwriting, likely a signature and date ("N. Alexandre 1936"), is located in the lower right corner. The overall composition is simple, with the leaf motifs equally distributed across the blue area and no additional decorative elements.
title: Wall Paper
